name: ServiceTitan onboarding labs
postCreateCommand: python -m pip install -r requirements.txt && npm install -g bun@1.1.38 && cd site && bun install --frozen-lockfile

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: Optional. Turns on live mode in the labs that use OpenAI (see the Keys column in labs/README.md). Every lab runs offline without it.

LANGSMITH_API_KEY.description: Optional. Sends lab 07 and 08 traces to LangSmith.

LIVEKIT_URL.description: Optional. LiveKit project URL for lab 04's live agent.

LIVEKIT_API_KEY.description: Optional. LiveKit API key for lab 04.

LIVEKIT_API_SECRET.description: Optional. LiveKit API secret for lab 04.
